claim: Option Alpha reports implied volatility contracted after about 90% of 1,546 earnings events.

evidence.quote: This means that about 90% of the time we saw implied volatility go through a crush or contraction.

claim: Alpaca offers index options including SPX, SPXW, VIX and XSP for live trading through its Trading API, and does not provide spot index data.

evidence.quote: Today, index options are available for live trading through the our Trading API and dashboard!
Alpaca does not currently provide index data through its Market Data offering.
